checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same hatchback, same position, unchanged details
must.why: Car matches in position and shape; tail lights, wheel, and plate look the same, with small softening.
Trees, houses, pole, cars, and shadow are all in place; fine foliage texture is slightly altered.

faults.what: The tonal contrast is a bit flatter and the car body is a mid-grey. The foliage is slightly different in detail. These are minor.

summary: A faithful black-and-white version with the same framing, car and street, and no visible problems beyond slight tonal flattening.
